program.name: Long Climb Session
program.subject: Climber / pull strength
program.blurb: Longer climbing strength days: pulls and holds, back and core, then pull volume.
program.about: Strength for the wall, with the time to do it properly. One day is pull-ups and dead hangs in straight sets, the next upper back and hanging core, the third pull volume in supersets with rows and grip work. Three days rotate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder variations.
program.split: Pull & hold / back & core / pull volume
